title: KUFE MEI HORAHA HAI MUSHKIL KUSHA KA MATAM
body:
KUFE MEI HORAHA HAI MUSHKIL KUSHA KA MATAM
GHAR MEI HAI FATIMA KE AB MURTAZA KA MATAM
1) Zainab tadap rahi hai Kulsoom roorahi hai
Hasnain karahe hai share e Khuda ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Sajde mei jis ke sar ko zaqmi kiya shaqi ne
Hota hai do jahaan mei us rehnuma ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Farshe aza pe aau zehra ko pursa dene
Ay rozedaro karlo ouqda kusha ka matam
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Nouha sunao Qaise?r Dunia ko aaj rookar
Matam hai deen e haq ke us peshwa ka matam
AZZ..Late Mirza Qaiser Ali Baig
